explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because upstream provenance records changed the handoff identity from need record IDs to source IDs. Job 2 then could not join provenance ranks back to coverage records, so every observed priority has upstream_rank 0 instead of preserving upstream provenance order. The visible upstream source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which emits record_id from source_id.
cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id/source_id/source_weight and preserving deterministic provenance identities and rank order.
In job_1 assemble_provenance, the emitted provenance row sets "record_id": record.get('source_id', "") while also setting "source_id": record.get("source_id", "").
Job 2 input evidence_sources therefore contains record_id values s01 through s08, while needs and coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
In job_2 prioritize, rank_by_record_id is keyed by evidence record_id and looked up with coverage record_id; the observed priorities all have upstream_rank 0.
